thread:
Maria: Quick heads-up — sprint docs backlog is spiking. We have three small but blocking PRs that need reviewer ownership and a merge slot: PR #723 (migration guide), #734 (SDK snippet examples), #741 (link fixes). #723 preview failed linkcheck in CI. Can someone pick up the migration guide and handle the linkcheck so we can merge in today's window?

Raj: I can take #723 but I'm on pager tilt until Friday morning. If pager fires I might need to drop it. Anyone else able to run the preview and try to reproduce the linkcheck locally?

Alex: I can run the preview and repro. @docs-preview-bot can you rerun the preview for #723? :eyes:

docs-preview-bot: Preview for PR #723 requested by Alex — initial result: failed (linkcheck). Preview URL: https://deploy.preview/pr/723 — Logs excerpt:
```
LinkCheckError: Broken link found: ../old-guides/auth-migration.md#token-scope
See file: docs/migrations/auth-migration.md: line 42
```

Sophia: That broken anchor looks like a rename from last quarter. I can patch the anchor in the migration guide (and add a redirect) unless someone already started. Also we should confirm the SDK snippets are covered next rotation — who is on reviewer rotation next week?

Jen: I'm +1 to review SDK snippets next week, I have capacity. For merges: do we still use the 4pm PST merge window today? I can queue merges then.

Tim: Quick reminder: don't merge until linkcheck and the design team's quick pass are green. Also please add a one-line changelog entry in `changelog.md` for the migration guide.

Maria: Great — plan: Alex reruns preview and posts new URL; Sophia patches the anchor and pushes; Jen will be reviewer for SDK snippets and will handle merge window if CI green. Raj takes #723 if his pager clears, otherwise Alex/Sophia will carry to merge.

Alex: Rerun kicked off: https://deploy.preview/pr/723/attempt-2 (status: running)

docs-preview-bot: Preview #723 attempt-2 complete — status: failed (local linkcheck still catching one broken anchor). New log snippet:
```
LinkCheckError: Broken anchor: docs/migrations/auth-migration.md -> #token-scope
Found references to #token-scope but anchor now is #token-scope-scopes
```

Sophia: Pushed a tiny fix: commit abc123 — updated anchor to `#token-scope-scopes` and added a redirect entry. I ran `mkdocs build` locally and linkcheck passed here. PTAL @Jen @Maria

Jen: Reviewing now. LGTM on the changed anchor and redirect. Adding my review and will merge during the 4pm PST window if design is OK. :thumbsup:

Tim: Design sign-off is OKed (I checked the migration example screenshot). Remember to include the changelog line: `docs: migration guide — auth token scope name change (PR #723)`

Maria: Thanks — Alex, can you kick the preview one more time and confirm green?

Alex: Kicked preview: https://deploy.preview/pr/723/attempt-3 — status: success. Linkcheck passed.

Sophia: Sweet. Moved the changelog note into `changelog.md` in the same PR.

Jen: Merged at 16:05 PST. No issues after merge. Thanks for the quick turn-around everyone :tada:

Maria: Amazing — appreciate the pickup. Action items: Sophia add a short note in the migration guide about the anchor rename, Jen will queue SDK snippet reviews tomorrow, Raj will take next migration guide if pager clear. I'll update the rotation doc to note this small gap we hit.

Raj: Thanks — will ping if pager clears and I can pick next one up.

Alex: If anyone sees the linkcheck flake again, try `mkdocs serve` + `mkdocs build --strict` locally, it's fast.

Maria: Closing thread — moving PRs to merged/assigned. :white_check_mark:
